Golf cart & bikes included! Description Welcome to 'Walton Rose,'  a 6-bedroom, 6-bathroom Inlet Beach home and Carriage House with Gulf views that sleeps 21. Guests will love being steps from the beach and a short stroll into Rosemary. Home features a private pool, putting green, an outdoor fireplace, and huge porches with beautiful views! Golf cart & bikes included! This stately beachside mansion has 2 generous front porches. Inside, guests will find wide-plank hardwood floors, exposed ceiling beams, and 3 guest bedrooms off a hallway that leads to a living area. 2 guest bedrooms have king beds, views of the front porch, and private bathrooms with shower/tub combos. A third guest bedroom has a king bed and a private bathroom with shower. A cozy living area has a guest bathroom, a small dining table, a queen sleeper-sofa and armchairs surrounding a TV. French doors open to a covered outdoor patio with sofa and chairs that step down to a pool deck and courtyard. A deep pool with a sun shelf is flanked by chaise lounge chairs and a premium gas grilling station. Behind the pool is a large putting green. Once the sun has set, guests will enjoy dining by an oversized brick fireplace. On the second floor, exposed ceiling beams and natural light create a calming environment for guests. A glass-front refrigerator and upright freezer surround a premium gas range in the open kitchen. An eat-in island divides the kitchen from the living area. A dining area has a coffee bar and French doors that open to an outdoor dining table with views of the pool below. A guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom with shower is off the living area. A loft on the third floor has Gulf views from a covered balcony and a bunk room with a full-over-full bunk bed and a twin-over-twin bunk bed. A private bathroom has a shower/tub combo. Walton Rose’s Carriage House feels sleek and modern. In the living area, a queen sleeper sofa provides extra space and faces a spacious kitchen and dine-in island. A shared bathroom has a soaking tub, shower, and a washer and dryer. A loft bedroom has a queen bed, twin sleeper-sofa, and half bathroom on the second floor. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Gulf views -175 yards from the Gulf -Private pool **Pool heating is available for this property for $25 per day** -Spacious porches -Putting Green -Carriage House -Golf Cart (6-seater) -Stand-alone ice maker -Private gated courtyard -10 adult bikes -4 dedicated parking spots -Steps from Rosemary Beach BEACH ACCESS Two access points, just a short walk from the home: 1. Winston Lane Public Access. Located less than .08 away. This access is on the western border of Inlet Beach where it meets Rosemary. There is not public parking available, but plenty of bike racks if you choose to ride a bike. 2. Inlet Beach Public Access. This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about 200 yards south of US Hwy 98. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Four parking spaces available (4 driveway). No street parking allowed. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 10 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost.
